 505|    def _zip_dir(dir_path: str) -> io.BytesIO:
 506|        """Create an in-memory ZIP archive of a directory."""
 507|        buf = io.BytesIO()
 508|        base = os.path.abspath(dir_path)
 509|        with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
 510|            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
 511|                # Skip hidden dirs
 512|                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
 513|                for f in files:
 514|                    if f.startswith('.'):
 515|                        continue
 516|                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
 517|                    arcname = os.path.relpath(fp, base)
 518|                    zf.write(fp, arcname)
 519|        buf.seek(0)
 520|        return buf

 820|    def _fix_mermaid(code: str) -> str:
 821|        """Auto-fix common LLM-generated Mermaid syntax errors.
 822|        Applied before rendering to improve success rate.
 823|        """
 824|        lines = code.split('\n')
 825|        fixed = []
 826|
 827|        for line in lines:
 828|            # Fix 1: Unquoted labels with special chars in node definitions
 829|            # e.g.  Node[Some Label with spaces]  →  Node["Some Label with spaces"]
 830|            # But don't break already-quoted labels
 831|            m = re.match(r'^(\s*)(\w+)(\[(?!["\']).*\])', line)
 832|            if m:
 833|                indent, nid, label = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
 834|                inner = label[1:-1]  # strip [ and ]
 835|                # Only quote if contains special chars
 836|                if any(c in inner for c in ' ()，。、；：！？｛｝【】《》（）'):
 837|                    line = f'{indent}{nid}["{inner}"]'
 838|
 839|            # Fix 2: Single-quote issues — convert to double quotes in labels
 840|            # Fix 3: Chinese quotes in labels
 841|            line = line.replace('"', "'").replace('"', "'")
 842|
 843|            # Fix 4: classDiagram class names with spaces
 844|            if line.strip().startswith('class ') and 'classDiagram' not in line:
 845|                cls_match = re.match(r'(\s*class\s+)([^{]+)(.*)', line)
 846|                if cls_match:
 847|                    prefix, name, rest = cls_match.group(1), cls_match.group(2).strip(), cls_match.group(3)
 848|                    if ' ' in name and not name.startswith('`'):
 849|                        line = f'{prefix}`{name}`{rest}'
 850|
 851|            # Fix 5: stateDiagram — state names with spaces need quotes
 852|            if 'stateDiagram' not in line and ' --> ' in line:
 853|                parts = line.split(' --> ')
 854|                if len(parts) == 2:
 855|                    src = parts[0].strip()
 856|                    dst = parts[1].strip()
 857|                    # Only fix if it's a state machine transition with unquoted spaces
 858|                    # Leave sequence diagram participant names alone
 859|
 860|            # Fix 6: flowchart edge labels with unescaped pipe chars
 861|            # e.g.  A -->|label with | inside| B  — rare, skip for now
 862|
 863|            # Fix 7: Empty lines in the middle of a class definition
 864|            # (already handled by the diff; keep as-is)
 865|
 866|            # Fix 8: node IDs with . / inside them (from file paths)
 867|            if 'flowchart' in code[:50].lower() or 'graph ' in code[:50].lower():
 868|                m = re.match(r'^(\s*)([a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+)(\[.*\]|\{.*\}|\(\(.*\)\)|\(.*\))', line)
 869|                if m:
 870|                    nid = m.group(2)
 871|                    if '.' in nid or '/' in nid:
 872|                        safe_id = nid.replace('.', '_').replace('/', '_')
 873|                        line = line.replace(nid, safe_id, 1)
 874|
 875|            fixed.append(line)
 876|
 877|        return '\n'.join(fixed)

 883|    @app.post("/api/v1/diagrams/render")
 884|    async def render_diagram(request: RenderRequest):
 885|        """Render a Mermaid/PUML diagram to SVG via Kroki.io.
 886|        Auto-fixes common LLM syntax errors. Falls back gracefully.
 887|
 888|        Accepts JSON: { code: "...", format: "mermaid" | "plantuml" }
 889|        Returns: { format: "svg", svg: "<svg>...", fixed: bool }
 890|        """
 891|        code = (request.code or "").strip()
 892|        fmt = (request.format or "mermaid").strip()
 893|
 894|        if not code:
 895|            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No diagram code provided")
 896|
 897|        # Strip markdown fences
 898|        fm = re.search(r'```(?:mermaid|mmd|plantuml)?\s*\n(.*?)```', code, re.DOTALL)
 899|        if fm:
 900|            code = fm.group(1).strip()
 901|
 902|        if not code:
 903|            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Empty diagram after stripping fences")
 904|
 905|        # Auto-fix for Mermaid
 906|        was_fixed = False
 907|        if fmt == 'mermaid':
 908|            fixed_code = _fix_mermaid(code)
 909|            if fixed_code != code:
 910|                was_fixed = True
 911|                code = fixed_code
 912|
 913|        # Render via Kroki
 914|        try:
 915|            encoded = b64.urlsafe_b64encode(
 916|                zlib.compress(code.encode('utf-8'), 9)
 917|            ).decode('ascii')
 918|            url = f"https://kroki.io/{fmt}/svg/{encoded}"
 919|            req = urllib_req.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'DevAgent/3.4'})
 920|            with urllib_req.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
 921|                svg_data = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
 922|
 923|            # Validate it's real SVG
 924|            if '<svg' not in svg_data[:200]:
 925|                raise HTTPException(status_code=500,
 926|                    detail=f"Kroki returned non-SVG: {svg_data[:200]}")
 927|
 928|            return {"format": "svg", "svg": svg_data, "fixed": was_fixed}
 929|        except HTTPException:
 930|            raise
 931|        except urllib_err.HTTPError as e:
 932|            err_body = e.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[:300]
 933|            raise HTTPException(status_code=422,
 934|                detail=f"Kroki render error: {err_body}")
 935|        except Exception as e:
 936|            raise HTTPException(status_code=500,
 937|                detail=f"Rendering failed: {str(e)}")

1081|    @app.websocket("/api/v2/tasks/{task_id}/interactive")
1082|    async def interactive_session(websocket: WebSocket, task_id: str,
1083|                                   mode: str = "observe"):
1084|        """Bidirectional WebSocket for real-time task interaction.
1085|
1086|        Client receives: progress snapshots, approval requests, agent questions, tool events
1087|        Client sends: commands (pause/resume/abort/redirect/inject),
1088|                      approval responses, question answers
1089|
1090|        Query params:
1091|            mode: "controller" (can send commands) or "observe" (read-only, default)
1092|            session_token: Optional token for reconnection
1093|        """
1094|        await websocket.accept()
1095|
1096|        from ..agentic.session import SessionManager, ClientRole, ClientTransport
1097|        from ..agentic.interaction import UserCommand, CommandType
1098|
1099|        # Get session manager from app state (or create a simple in-process one)
1100|        session_mgr = getattr(app.state, 'session_manager', None)
1101|        use_real_session = session_mgr is not None
1102|
1103|        if use_real_session:
1104|            role = ClientRole.CONTROLLER if mode == "controller" else ClientRole.OBSERVER
1105|            client = await session_mgr.register_client(
1106|                task_id, role=role, transport="websocket"
1107|            )
1108|        else:
1109|            client_id = f"ws_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
1110|            client = None  # Fallback: no session manager
1111|
1112|        try:
1113|            # Send connection acknowledgment
1114|            await websocket.send_json({
1115|                "type": "session.created",
1116|                "task_id": task_id,
1117|                "data": {
1118|                    "client_id": client.client_id if client else client_id,
1119|                    "mode": mode,
1120|                    "message": "Connected to interactive session",
1121|                },
1122|                "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
1123|            })
1124|
1125|            if use_real_session and client:
1126|                # Background task: forward events to this WebSocket client
1127|                async def event_forwarder():
1128|                    while client.is_connected:
1129|                        try:
1130|                            event = await asyncio.wait_for(
1131|                                client.message_queue.get(), timeout=1.0
1132|                            )
1133|                            # Skip internal _seq field
1134|                            clean_event = {k: v for k, v in event.items()
1135|                                          if not k.startswith("_")}
1136|                            await websocket.send_json(clean_event)
1137|                        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
1138|                            continue
1139|                        except WebSocketDisconnect:
1140|                            break
1141|                        except Exception:
1142|                            break
1143|
1144|                forwarder_task = asyncio.create_task(event_forwarder())
1145|            else:
1146|                forwarder_task = None
1147|
1148|            # Main loop: receive commands/messages from client
1149|            while True:
1150|                try:
1151|                    raw = await asyncio.wait_for(websocket.receive_text(), timeout=30)
1152|                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
1153|                    # Send heartbeat
1154|                    try:
1155|                        await websocket.send_json({
1156|                            "type": "heartbeat",
1157|                            "task_id": task_id,
1158|                            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
1159|                        })
1160|                    except Exception:
1161|                        break
1162|                    continue
1163|                except WebSocketDisconnect:
1164|                    break
1165|
1166|                try:
1167|                    msg = json.loads(raw)
1168|                except json.JSONDecodeError:
1169|                    await websocket.send_json({
1170|                        "type": "error",
1171|                        "data": {"message": "Invalid JSON"},
1172|                        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
1173|                    })
1174|                    continue
1175|
1176|                msg_type = msg.get("type", "")
1177|
1178|                # Route commands to InteractionController via SessionManager
1179|                if msg_type == "command.pause":
1180|                    await _route_command(task_id, client_id, CommandType.PAUSE,
1181|                                        session_mgr, msg)
1182|                elif msg_type == "command.resume":
1183|                    await _route_command(task_id, client_id, CommandType.RESUME,
1184|                                        session_mgr, msg)
1185|                elif msg_type == "command.abort":
1186|                    await _route_command(task_id, client_id, CommandType.ABORT,
1187|                                        session_mgr, msg)
1188|                elif msg_type == "command.retry":
1189|                    await _route_command(task_id, client_id, CommandType.RETRY,
1190|                                        session_mgr, msg)
1191|                elif msg_type == "command.redirect":
1192|                    await _route_command(task_id, client_id, CommandType.REDIRECT,
1193|                                        session_mgr, msg)
1194|                elif msg_type == "command.inject":
1195|                    await _route_command(task_id, client_id,
1196|                                        CommandType.INJECT_CONTEXT, session_mgr, msg)
1197|                elif msg_type == "approval.response":
1198|                    approval_id = msg.get("data", {}).get("approval_id", "")
1199|                    resolution = msg.get("data", {}).get("resolution", "deny")
1200|                    note = msg.get("data", {}).get("note", "")
1201|                    # Try ThreadChannel first (for background agents)
1202|                    tc = getattr(app.state, '_thread_channels', {}).get(task_id)
1203|                    if tc and tc.resolve(approval_id, resolution, note):
1204|                        pass  # resolved in background thread
1205|                    else:
1206|                        controller = session_mgr.get_controller(task_id) if session_mgr else None
1207|                        if controller:
1208|                            await controller.resolve_approval(approval_id, resolution, note)
1209|                elif msg_type == "question.response":
1210|                    question_id = msg.get("data", {}).get("question_id", "")
1211|                    answer = msg.get("data", {}).get("answer", "")
1212|                    tc = getattr(app.state, '_thread_channels', {}).get(task_id)
1213|                    if tc and tc.resolve(question_id, "answered", answer):
1214|                        pass
1215|                    else:
1216|                        controller = session_mgr.get_controller(task_id) if session_mgr else None
1217|                        if controller:
1218|                            await controller.resolve_approval(question_id, answer)
1219|                elif msg_type == "review.response":
1220|                    review_id = msg.get("data", {}).get("review_id", "")
1221|                    decision = msg.get("data", {}).get("decision", "approve")
1222|                    feedback = msg.get("data", {}).get("feedback", "")
1223|                    suggestions = msg.get("data", {}).get("suggestions", [])
1224|                    # Try ThreadChannel first
1225|                    tc = getattr(app.state, '_thread_channels', {}).get(task_id)
1226|                    if tc and tc.resolve(review_id, decision, feedback, suggestions):
1227|                        pass  # resolved in bg thread
1228|                    else:
1229|                        controller = session_mgr.get_controller(task_id) if session_mgr else None
1230|                        if controller and controller.review_gate:
1231|                            controller.review_gate.resolve_review(
1232|                                review_id, decision, feedback, suggestions
1233|                            )
1234|                elif msg_type == "ping":
1235|                    await websocket.send_json({
1236|                        "type": "pong",
1237|                        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
1238|                    })
1239|                else:
1240|                    # Unknown message type — echo for debugging
1241|                    await websocket.send_json({
1242|                        "type": "echo",
1243|                        "data": {"received": msg_type},
1244|                        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
1245|                    })
1246|
1247|        except WebSocketDisconnect:
1248|            pass
1249|        except Exception:
1250|            pass
1251|        finally:
1252|            if use_real_session and client:
1253|                client.is_connected = False
1254|                await session_mgr.unregister_client(task_id, client.client_id)
1255|            if forwarder_task:
1256|                forwarder_task.cancel()
1257|            try:
1258|                await websocket.close()
1259|            except Exception:
1260|                pass
